title: INFO matches type_text case-insensitively without trimming spaces, returns #N/A for memory keys, and reports "Automatic" for AutomaticExceptTables
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, INFO(type_text) matches type_text without regard to case ("RECALC" and "recalc" match) and without trimming leading or trailing spaces (" recalc" and "recalc " return #VALUE!). On Windows 64-bit Excel, "memavail", "memused", and "totmem" return #N/A; "recalc" returns "Automatic" even under Automatic-except-tables; "origin" returns "$A:" plus the calling sheet window's top-left cell ("$A:$C$5"); "release" returns "16.0"; "system" returns "pcdos"; and "numfile" counts worksheets (including hidden ones, excluding chart sheets). All 1,482 full-bank INFO rows match.
basis: Measured across all 19 INFO rows of DnaCalc dcuar_cell (rows 63-77, Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 1,482/1,482 full-bank rows match.
